No satellite thermal detections were found on this asset, but that doesn't prove there was no fire.

NASA FIRMS recorded zero thermal anomaly detections intersecting ASSET-F01 between 23 September and 23 October 2026. All four sensors (three VIIRS satellites and MODIS) covered every day of that period, so the lack of detections isn't a data gap.

The limits matter, though. Small, short-lived, cool, or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected, so this result can't rule out a fire. It also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any change on the land, or anything outside those dates.

In short: no fire signal was detected, and coverage was complete. If you need to confirm that no fire occurred, you would need additional evidence, such as burned-area imagery or a ground report.
